outcome: number of motor neurons in pelvic musculature
cohort: The study participants were fetuses from time-mated pregnant Wistar rats, divided into control, ETU-exposed affected, and ETU-exposed malformed groups.
finding: ETU administration to pregnant rats led to a reduced number of motor neurons in the pelvic musculature of their fetuses, altered enteric neurons in malformed fetuses, and sacral alterations in both affected and malformed fetuses.
gest_age: The fetuses were studied at gestational day 21.
